Subject: Novafin MAP - draft + post-call recap (v1.0)

Hi Laura / Alex \u00151 great to meet you both earlier. Thanks for the time and for walking us through Novafin's ingestion and compliance needs. Per our discovery, I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP v1.0) that captures the milestones we discussed, owners, and dependencies. High-level recap below and proposed next steps.

Milestones (proposed):
- P0: Finalize security/compliance requirements (Novafin: Procurement/Sec, Redwood: Security) \u00151 target: 08/20/2027
- P1: Private deployment scoping + network configuration (Novafin: Infra, Redwood: Eng) \u00151 target: 09/03/2027
- P2: Proof-of-concept (dedicated capacity) \u00151 target: 09/17/2027
- P3: Production rollout & SLA handoff \u00151 target: 10/01/2027

Owners/responsibilities: each milestone has a primary owner indicated in the attached MAP. Dependencies called out: SOC2 evidence, procurement PO, VPC peering details, and test data access.

Target close/commit: we're currently modeling an internal close date of 10/15/2027 for procurement and contract sign-off \u00151 this is flexible depending on procurement timeline.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached MAP (Novafin_MAP_v1.0.xlsx) and confirm owners and dates by EOD Thu 08/05.
2) Laura / Procurement: let us know the expected timeline for your security questionnaire and whether you need any vendor evidence from us (we can share SOC2 Type II summary and pen-test report).
3) I'll update the MAP based on your feedback and send a weekly checkpoint note each Monday with outstanding items.

Attachment: [Attachment: Novafin_MAP_v1.0.xlsx]

Thanks \u00151
